morbi.headline: Mixed week as falling freight and cheaper fuel balance declining tile export projections.
what_changed: Tile export market projections dropped to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following improved propane supply availability.
Ocean container freight rates for Morbi ceramics dropped by up to 50 percent.
Somany Ceramics announced a 5 MSM capacity hike via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports are projected to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for export shipments [d6c30857de2c]
Improved propane supply allowed Morbi ceramic units to cut higher-cost PNG consumption [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Destination-wise export volumes to assess the actual impact of the Rs 12,000-13,000 crore projection.
Propane vs PNG price differentials and fuel substitution levels across MSME ceramic kilns.
Details on Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking plan, including capex, funding mix, and location impact [0f642d309dd8].

surat.headline: Surat cluster sees policy approvals and lower crude costs, alongside diamond order recoveries.
what_changed: Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units representing Rs 1,521 crore in investment [021c037e28d9].
Crude oil prices dropped 17% in 10 days, providing input-cost relief to local textile units [71350aa24679].
stress_signals: Surat Position Printing Association announced a 15% rate hike and enforced a strict 45-day payment term post-Diwali [ad48975ddfcf].
FOSTA held meetings addressing ongoing transportation and parcel dispatch issues faced by traders [d1f9f2e9444f].
improvement_signals: Surat diamond units halved their Diwali holiday break due to improved orders, supported by demand recovery after a four-year slump [5fc0b7b85616, bae3b8d48691].
MANTRA expanded into MedTech with medical textile testing and was selected for a national textile sustainability project [8cfd965ad293, 5e7cd22236e9].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital cycles and cash flow realization under the newly mandated 45-day printing payment terms [ad48975ddfcf].
Track execution timelines and sub-segment allocations for the Rs 1,521 crore textile policy investments [021c037e28d9].
Observe compliance with the Textile Ministry's new capacity database tracking drive [5177389da7be].
